method.ant_default_excludes: ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT; effective list must be captured from pinned Ant runtime before execution
method.scope_limit: Counts are matching source paths, not JUnit-discovered test classes, test methods, executed tests or pass/fail results.
method.selection_contract_digest: SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of each target object with selection_contract_sha256 omitted; property order as stored; no trailing newline.

targets.selection_semantics: Ant FileSet include union followed by exclude filtering; each batch is independent; later batches can select files excluded from an earlier batch.

discovery_contract.meaning: Ant JUnit batchtest does not filter non-test classes unless skipNonTests is enabled. The selected path count is not a discovered test-class or test-method count.

report_collision_analysis.required_control: Use distinct immutable report roots for source-test and packaged-JAR test targets; bind paths and report digests separately; fail if report roots overlap.
